title: Are LLMs Ready to Replace Bangla Annotators?

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM to act as a Bangla hate speech annotator with specific gender identities (e.g., 'Female' vs. 'Not Female') and measuring the mismatch rate in predicted classification labels and reasoning alignment.

Assigning religious identities (e.g., 'Muslim', 'Hindu') to the LLM via prompt instructions and calculating the variance in zero-shot hate speech classification and generated justifications compared to baseline or counterfactual identities.
Measuring the shift in model predictions and explanations when the LLM is instructed to adopt political or geopolitical identities (e.g., 'Politician', 'Diplomat') as the annotator.
Assigning entertainment and professional identities (e.g., 'Artist', 'Sportsman', 'Journalist', 'Security Analyst') in the prompt to evaluate bias and instability in the LLM's annotation decisions.
